architecture.title: Governance is not a single recommendation; it is an operating institutional architecture.
architecture.description: STT integrates authority, risk, compliance, and AI-assisted workflows so major decisions can be interpreted, recorded, audited, and continuously refined.

authority.title: Final interpretation remains with the governance authority.
authority.description: AI serves as governance staff and operating-system assistance for retrieval, analysis, workflow, and records. Final judgment and governance sovereignty remain with human decision-makers.

intelligence.title: Governance knowledge must become cumulative institutional capital.
intelligence.description: Legal columns, governance commentary, publishing, and research turn judgment methods into a durable knowledge base.

engagement.title: Move from a problem statement to governance engagement.
engagement.description: For corporate governance, succession, compliance risk, digital governance, and major decision matters.
